page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Rectius" is read from the hyphenated "Re-" at the line end and the ligature in "ftius". The Greek phrase at the foot of the second paragraph is hard to read, especially the words after "τρο-" and the final word, and is marked [?]. The word after "concu-" at the foot of the page is partly unclear and is marked [?]. The page number reads "814" (set as "ʂ14"). The spelling "afsiduus" and "Ecclesiastes" follows the printed form with long s rendered as plain s.
